claim: Nursultanov, Rowlett & Sher (arXiv:1905.00259, published Ann. Math. Quebec 49 (2025) 1-61) prove that the heat trace of a curvilinear polygonal domain (Dirichlet/Neumann/Robin/mixed) in an arbitrary surface has a complete polyhomogeneous conormal short-time asymptotic expansion to all orders, and give the first three terms explicitly through the constant term a_0.
stance_target: What corner invariants for curvilinear polygons are established in the literature, and to what order
scope_conditions: Curvilinear polygonal domains in arbitrary smooth surfaces, finitely many vertices, Friedrichs extension at each vertex
quoted_support: Tr H^Omega(t) has a complete polyhomogeneous conormal expansion in t as t->0. Moreover, the first few terms of this expansion have the form Tr H^Omega(t) = a_{-1} t^{-1} + a_{-1/2} t^{-1/2} + a_0 + O(t^{1/2} log t)

claim: The explicit corner-angle contribution to the constant term a_0 in NRS's expansion is (pi^2-alpha_j^2)/(24 pi alpha_j) at vertices with matching boundary-condition type on both adjacent edges, and (-pi^2-2alpha_j^2)/(48 pi alpha_j) at vertices where the boundary condition type changes -- these are angle-only, with no curvature-corner interaction term; that interaction first appears one order later, at t^{1/2}, per Looi-Sher (arXiv:2512.04422).
stance_target: The order at which boundary curvature and corner geometry first interact in the heat trace
scope_conditions: Curvilinear polygonal domains, constant term a_0 of the heat trace expansion
quoted_support: a_0 = 1/(12 pi) int_Omega K(z) dz + 1/(12 pi) int_{d Omega} k_g(x) dx - 1/(2 pi) sum_{j in E_R} int_{E_j} kappa_j(x) dx + sum_{j in V_=} (pi^2-alpha_j^2)/(24 pi alpha_j) + sum_{j in V_!=} (-pi^2-2 alpha_j^2)/(48 pi alpha_j).

claim: NRS's published version carries DOI 10.1007/s40316-024-00237-4 in Annales mathematiques du Quebec, volume 49, pages 1-61, received 2 March 2024, accepted 22 March 2024, published 27 December 2024, issue dated April 2025 -- matching the DOI already listed in the arXiv metadata.
